_note: viewer3d.html?model=contest_corridor 的清单（标准档 + 低档 glb）。坐标 = glTF（Y 朝上，米）。设定见 docs/landmarks/contest_corridor.md。卡（L89）写圣都分三环，中环是「竞赛与狂欢回廊」：本模型是中环的一段——沿半径 200 m 环带的两层拱廊 + 廊内比试场 + 廊外帐篷集市与巨轮。体量上限按「片区」放宽到 std 1.6 / low 0.8 MB（单栋默认 0.6/0.3）：一个模型含三段场地。

credit.zh: 自建模型；贴图 Poly Haven / ambientCG（CC0）
credit.en: Own model; textures Poly Haven / ambientCG (CC0)

desc.zh: 沿中环环带排开的两层拱廊：一层柱列与券墙、二层贴墙柱与发光窗带，檐部与女儿墙压金线（卡原文只写「竞赛与狂欢回廊」，形制为仓库推断）。
desc.en: The two-storey arcade running along the mid-ring: a colonnade and spandrel wall below, engaged columns and a glowing window band above (the card names the arcade only; the form is a repo inference).

desc.zh: 廊内的沙地比试场：木栏围合，一侧四级看台，两端立无字几何旗门。——仓库推断
desc.en: The contest field inside the arcade: sand, timber fencing, a four-tier stand on one side and wordless geometric banner gates at both ends. Repo inference.

desc.zh: 廊外的帐篷集市：四顶方帐围着中央圆亭，另有一座二十四米半径的巨轮（纹样化，无字）。——仓库推断
desc.en: The fair outside the arcade: four square tents around a central rotunda, plus a wheel of 24 m radius (patterned, wordless). Repo inference.

desc.zh: 台基铺装沿环带铺开，外侧环道，中央一条大道通向廊内比试场；两侧草坪与行道树。——仓库推断
desc.en: Terraced paving along the ring, an outer ring road and a central avenue leading to the lists, with lawns and street trees on both sides. Repo inference.
